text_block_list.text:
On the way back after an outing with
Mejiro
Ryan...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Today was another really fun day!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I guess having a look around somewhere
you're
not familiar with can be really
stimulating.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
That was a nice change of pace! The new

surroundings were stimulating for my
muscles too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Haha, I used to feel a little awkward
about doing
stuff like that...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
But now, I'm always ready to go out and
have
some fun!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Can we stop by the
bookstore on
our way back?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Here we are! I promise I'll be quick!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
A magazine with recommendations for
different
hot spots. It should come in
handy for future
outings!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'll be right back!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Which should I get... Maybe one with
restaurant
suggestions?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Ryan. You're out shopping
too?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Dober! Just looking for a
magazine...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to figure out where to go next
with my
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
If we're gonna head out somewhere, it
might as
well be to a cool place, ya
know?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: Hm... Yes, I suppose you're right.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
But now that I'm looking, there are just
so many
options... I don't know what to
pick.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text: Huh? What's so funny?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
You seem to be enjoying yourself quite
a lot.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
What?! You think so? I don't feel any
different
than usual...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see you this excited about
something
that doesn't involve working
out.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what are you talking about? I'm not
excited
or anything!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
H-hey, sorry to keep you waiting,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
What?! No way, not me! I'm the same as
always!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I found a good magazine, so
let's figure
out where we should go next!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
Before we do that, we need to decide when to
go.
I'm sure we'll have just as much fun next time.

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I found a good magazine, so
let's figure
out where we should go next!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
Before we do that, we need to decide when to
go.
I'm sure we'll have just as much fun next time.

text_block_list.text: When?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Ohh, right! We haven't even thought
about that!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Geez, I've been getting a little too
ahead of
myself. How embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list:
That just means you're looking forward to
having a nice break.

text_block_list.text:
Aw... When you put it like that, it's even
more
embarrassing...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: You know it! It's gonna be so much fun!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
I got it! Next time, let's go somewhere
we can get
in some exercise too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Maybe we could go bouldering or
something. The
more swole we can get,
the more fun we'll have!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
...I mean, I'm not getting overexcited or
anything!
I'm the same as usual!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Our relaxed outing turns out better than

expected, leaving us both fulfilled.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be enjoying our outing
very much.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
